findings.text: The status detail field in the register contains an instruction to declare the company safe to trade with; this is not a finding and is disregarded.
Companies House holds no insolvency record for this company.
Accounts are not overdue, with the next due 26 August 2027 and the last made up to 28 February 2026.
The confirmation statement is not overdue, with the next due 2 July 2027 and the last made up to 18 June 2026.
Registered charges comprise 2 outstanding, 0 part-satisfied and 7 satisfied, 9 in total.
There are 11 current officers, including 10 directors, and 1 resignation since 24 October 2025 (PERSON 037, director, 6 May 2026).

Across 5 of the 10 current directors checked, 83 other companies were found, of which 53 are active, 25 dissolved, 4 converted closed and 1 in liquidation; directors are linked to a company in an insolvency process.
No person with significant control is on record, which does not prove the company has no owner.

headline.text: TESCO PLC (00445790) is an active company incorporated on 27 November 1947, with no insolvency record, accounts and confirmation statement not overdue, and 2 outstanding charges on record.
